decisions.decision: 25 CDEs covering core financial statements, not sector-specific
decisions.rationale: Covers balance sheet (8), income statement (8), cash flow (4), per-share (3), other (2). Sector-specific CDEs (e.g., insurance premiums, bank NIM) are Consumable zone work. Base zone normalizes to universal financial concepts.

decisions.decision: All 3,285 us-gaap concepts get a row in concept_mappings
decisions.rationale: Complete census enables coverage analysis and future extension. Unmapped (tier 3) rows are explicitly 'not yet mapped' rather than silently missing. Downstream can filter by tier or status.

decisions.decision: Tiered matching: exact (1.0) > prefix (0.7) > pattern (0.6) > unmapped (0.0)
decisions.rationale: Exact matches are curated and authoritative. Prefix matches catch known variants with high confidence. Pattern matches are regex-based and less precise. Clear confidence hierarchy makes approval decisions easier.

decisions.decision: Tier 3 bypasses the human approval gate
decisions.rationale: Unmapped concepts don't need human review — they're explicitly 'not yet mapped' with confidence 0.0. Requiring approval for 3,000+ unmapped concepts would make the gate unusable. Only tier 1+2 proposals go through staging/approval.

The staging module (write/read JSON, apply_gate, approve/reject) is domain-agnostic. Same interface: dicts with status/mapping_id/confidence fields. DRY > copy-paste. No staging.py needed in this module.

decisions.decision: All revenue variants map to one CDE (Revenue)
decisions.rationale: Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet, SalesRevenueGoodsNet all normalize to CDE-015. Gross/net/segment distinctions are Consumable zone. Base zone answers 'what is this company's revenue?'

Each concept maps to one financial statement (balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow, other). Depreciation goes to income_statement, not cash_flow. Cross-statement analysis is a downstream concern.
alternatives_considered: No statement assignment (less useful for filtering)

decisions.decision: Heuristic categories for unmapped concepts via substring matching
decisions.rationale: Even unmapped concepts benefit from rough categorization (e.g., concepts containing 'Tax' → income_statement/tax). Enables coverage analysis by financial statement even for unmapped concepts. Falls back to other/uncategorized.
